Pokémon Exploration Team Theme |olmteam=Team Kamei |scenario=松井亜弥 |storyboard=浅田裕二 |director=浅田裕二 |art=高橋英吉 |footnotes= * ''[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=y5wGtHkCY0Y Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Sky - Beyond Time & Darkness]'' (English) on [[YouTube]] }} '''Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Sky - Beyond Time & Darkness''' (Japanese: '''ポケモン不思議のダンジョン 空の探検隊 時と闇をめぐる 最後の冒険''' ''Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Sky: The Final Adventure Crossing Time and Darkness'') is an {{pkmn|animation|animated}} adaptation of the spin-off games [[Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Time and Explorers of Darkness|Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Time, Explorers of Darkness]], and [[Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Sky|Explorers of Sky]], continuing from ''[[Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Time & Darkness]]''. It first aired in Japan on April 12, 2009 and in the United States on October 9, 2009. A DVD of the English dub was given to those who pre-ordered [[Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Sky]] from GameStop. This episode was released on the Japanese and English ''Pokémon'' [[YouTube]] channels on July 3, 2015 and October 22, 2015, respectively, for the release of [[Pokémon Super Mystery Dungeon]]. This episode was also made available on [[Pokémon TV]]. {{spoilers}} ==Blurb== Once upon a time, there was a world where all Pokémon communicated with each other by speaking. Here in this world, we find a Piplup, who was once a boy, and a Chimchar who dreams of forming a Pokémon Exploration Team. Which, after meeting, is exactly what they did, calling their Exploration Team the "Poképals". Through dedication and arduous training, The Poképals rose to glory. And now, at last... Their final adventure is upon them. ==Plot== ===Intro=== ====The History of the Time Gear==== In the world of Pokémon, there are rare and precious items known as the [[Time Gear]]s. They are protected by the legendary Temporal Pokémon {{mdc|Dialga|2}}, along with {{mdc|Uxie|2}}, {{p|Azelf}} and {{p|Mesprit}}. Then one day, time started to behave strangely, starting from a dungeon and spreading everywhere, driving the Pokémon berserk. ====[[Wigglytuff's Guild]]==== Pokémon formed {{md|Team|exploration team}}s, who help Pokémon find lost possessions and occasionally explore [[mystery dungeon|dungeon]]s and recover treasures deep within them. While they do this, the flow of time brings forth disaster, throwing the {{OBP|Pokémon World|Mystery Dungeon}} into a state of crisis. ===The Story=== {{mdc|Grovyle|2}}, [[Team Poképals|Chimchar and Piplup]] find a glowing inscription similar to that on Chimchar's [[Relic Fragment]]. {{mdc|Lapras|2}} appears, as sent by Wigglytuff's Guild to bring them to the [[Hidden Land]]. They ride on Lapras' back as a flock of {{p|Pelipper}} circles overhead. Meanwhile, back at the guild, the Guild members talk about [[Team Poképals]], and wonder how they are doing. {{p|Corphish}} butts in, explaining that the team has found the Hidden Land, and how the Relic Fragment fell into Chimchar's possession. {{mdc|Sunflora|2}} points out that the Relic Fragment can bring them to the [[Temporal Tower]], and to Dialga. Guildmaster {{mdc|Wigglytuff|2}} states that Chimchar and Piplup, for that reason, have been chosen by the Fragment. {{mdc|Bidoof|2}} comments on how cool that sounds, and {{mdc|Loudred|2}} points out that as they speak, Team Poképals are riding on Lapras' back to the Hidden Land. However, the Guildmaster has fallen asleep with his eyes open. Meanwhile, Grovyle tells Piplup and Chimchar that Temporal Tower has started to collapse, and that when he took the fragment from [[Treeshroud Forest]], time stopped there. He says that they need to fight on to stop the tower from collapsing, but Dialga had already turned into [[Primal Dialga]]. Both Piplup and Chimchar are shocked, and Chimchar says that if that's true, they'll need to go to the Tower and place the Gears onto the mouthpiece to restore time. Grovyle says that Dialga will try to stop them by force, and they'll need to defeat Dialga. Both Piplup and Chimchar are stunned. Piplup tells Lapras to go faster, when Lapras spots the passage to the Hidden Land. Lapras speeds up, then suddenly starts to fly. However, Grovyle states they're simply in the Sea of Time. Lapras states that the Hidden Land is just ahead of the Sea of Time as they enter the Hidden Land. They spot the Hidden Land, and Piplup recalls how he met Chimchar - how Piplup was washed up on a {{mdc|beach|2}} after being transformed from a human into a Pokémon, how the duo registered as an exploration team in Wigglytuff's Guild, and what they went through together. Piplup becomes philosophical, saying that whether it's about the future or him being a human, he still doesn't remember anything, and it doesn't matter if he's a human or a Pokémon, he came with Chimchar to the Hidden Land, and they have come here to save the world for everyone. Grovyle spots Temporal Tower, and Lapras explains they need to ride the Rainbow Stoneship to reach it. They arrive at the Old Ruins, and notice the pattern at the top of the pyramid is the same as the one on the Relic Fragment. They spot Temporal Tower in the sky and a tablet on the pyramid with ancient writing, which Grovyle understands. Grovyle explains that his understanding of the writing came from doing a lot of research with Piplup in the future - however, Piplup doesn't remember any of this. Grovyle translates the writing, and it seems that the Old Ruins are the Rainbow Stoneship. Meanwhile, a strange distortion is happening at the base of the Pyramid. Grovyle walks over to the center of the pattern, and brushes away a patch of dirt, revealing a hole; a perfect fit for the Relic Fragment. he tells Chimchar to place the Fragment in so they can ride the Stoneship to the Tower. Just as he places it in though, a {{m|Dark Pulse}} hits him and sends the Fragment flying. A {{p|Sableye}} grabs it, and more appear from the distortion at the base of the Pyramid. They surround Team Poképals, and Chimchar yells to give the Fragment back. They are disturbed by laughing as {{mdc|Dusknoir|2}} appears. The Sableye gives the Fragment to Dusknoir, who congratulates his underling. Grovyle demands that he tell them why he's here. He says that with Dialga's help, he [[Time travel|came from the future]] to settle things once and for all. He leaves, telling the Sableye to take care of them. The team leaps into action as Dusknoir leaves. A dark cloud appears over the Guild as Corphish and Sunflora prepare to use {{m|Bubble Beam}} and {{m|Petal Dance}} respectively. However, Wigglytuff stops them, saying that even his {{m|Hyper Voice}} won't stop it. He reassures them that Team Poképals can solve this, even if time stops, and to have faith in them. The guild members join hands in solidarity as time freezes. Meanwhile, Team Poképals fend off the Sableye's attacks. Chimchar using {{m|Flamethrower}}, Piplup using {{m|Hydro Pump}} and Grovyle using {{m|Bullet Seed}} seems to put them out of action, but they get back up. Meanwhile, Dusknoir retreats back to the time portal with the Relic Fragment. The three combine their {{m|Whirlpool}}, {{m|Fire Spin}}, and {{m|Energy Ball}} into one attack and knock the Sableye out. Just as Dusknoir reaches the portal, Grovyle holds him back by grabbing his tail. Dusknoir is shocked that they took out all the Sableye, and acknowledges them for their strength. He uses {{m|Rapid Spin}} to throw them off, then he proceeds to battle them, hitting them with a {{m|Dark Pulse}}. Grovyle tells them there must be some way to defeat him. Piplup says that if they give up, all of their friends will be frozen in time forever. Piplup suggests doing the same thing as they did against the Sableye, but Dusknoir charges {{m|Shadow Ball}}. Grovyle says that their attacks won't do much against that type of energy, but they try it anyway. Much to everyone's surprise, the combination of Whirlpool, Energy Ball and Fire Spin push the Shadow Ball back and defeat Dusknoir. The Sableye panic and flee. Chimchar grabs the Relic Fragment and rushes up the Pyramid. Dusknoir stops Grovyle and Piplup. He tells them that if they start the flow of time again all the Pokémon of the future will disappear, along with their future selves. Grovyle tells Piplup not to listen to him. When Piplup asks Grovyle if it's true, Grovyle answers yes - but says that if they do that, all the Pokémon in the present will live in peace, and that's why they went to the present in the first place. Grovyle continues, explaining that he saw the sun rise for the first time upon coming to the present. The beauty of the sight, as well as feeling the life from time's flow around him - in stark contrast to the future, where everyone has lost their desire to live - strengthened his resolve to see the mission through. Grovyle and Piplup were fully prepared for the sacrifice when they initially set out. Despite not remembering that promise, Piplup asserts that he is still determined to continue. Chimchar shouts down to hurry up. Grovyle reminds Piplup that Chimchar doesn't know, and would be devastated should Piplup leave his side - but during their conversation, Dusknoir sneaks away. Chimchar grows impatient and decides to make preparations without them, when Dusknoir attacks him with Dark Pulse. Dusknoir grabs the Relic Fragment just as Piplup and Grovyle arrive, only for Chimchar to retaliate and send the fragment flying into Piplup's hands. Dusknoir fires another pulse at Piplup, but Grovyle takes the hit, and Dusknoir collapses to the ground in exhaustion. In a rage, Grovyle restrains Dusknoir and makes for the portal - he figures that since Dusknoir won't leave, he'll just have to forcibly take Dusknoir back to the future with him. Grovyle tells the others that he can't come back again, and they'll have to take on Dialga without him. He tosses the Time Gears to Piplup, telling him he was happy to have met him. He jumps into the portal with tears in his eyes, and the portal vanishes shortly afterwards. Chimchar starts to pick up the Time Gears and resolves to make the future a better place for Grovyle, unaware that Grovyle would not be able to see it. Chimchar says he's sorry to Piplup, and that Grovyle's parting is heartbreaking. Piplup can't bear to tell Chimchar the truth, as he knows Chimchar will feel the most pain when Piplup disappears - this will be the last adventure they'll have together. Chimchar decides to go and defeat Dialga so Grovyle's sacrifice won't be in vain. With a renewed vigor, Piplup gives Chimchar the fragment and Chimchar gives Piplup the bag containing the Time Gears. Piplup drops the last one in. Chimchar places the fragment into the hole, and the Stoneship begins to rise. True to its name, the Rainbow Stoneship flies toward the Temporal Tower, leaving a rainbow trail of light. Piplup asks if Chimchar is ready. Chimchar says he is, and Piplup yells out to Dialga to wait for them. Meanwhile, a shadowed figure looms atop Temporal Tower. Primal Dialga raises its head and roars to the sky. ==Major events== * {{p|Piplup}} is revealed to have learned {{m|Hydro Pump}} and {{m|Whirlpool}}. * {{p|Chimchar}} is revealed to have learned {{m|Fire Spin}} and {{m|Flamethrower}}. * {{mdc|Dusknoir|2}} and {{mdc|Grovyle|2}} [[Time travel|return back to the future]]. * [[Team Poképals]] prepares to take on [[Primal Dialga]]. ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== * [[Team Poképals]] ** {{p|Piplup}} ** {{p|Chimchar}} * [[Wigglytuff's Guild]] ** {{p|Wigglytuff}} ({{mdc|Wigglytuff|2|Explorers of Time, Darkness, and Sky}}) ** {{p|Chatot}} ({{mdc|Chatot|2|Explorers of Time, Darkness, and Sky}}) ** {{p|Corphish}} ** {{p|Diglett}} ** {{p|Dugtrio}} ** {{p|Loudred}} ({{mdc|Loudred|2|Explorers of Time, Darkness, and Sky}}) ** {{p|Bidoof}} ({{mdc|Bidoof|2|Explorers of Time, Darkness, and Sky}}) ** {{p|Chimecho}} ** {{p|Croagunk}} ** {{p|Sunflora}} ({{mdc|Sunflora|2|Explorers of Time, Darkness, and Sky}}) * Team Razor Wind ** {{p|Zangoose}} ** {{p|Scyther}} ** {{p|Sandslash}} * Others ** {{p|Mesprit}} ** {{p|Azelf}} ** {{p|Uxie}} ({{mdc|Uxie|2|Explorers of Time, Darkness, and Sky}}) ** {{p|Gabite}} ** {{p|Drowzee}} ({{mdc|Drowzee|2|Explorers of Time, Darkness, and Sky}}) ** {{p|Sharpedo}} ** {{p|Weavile}} ** {{p|Gyarados}} ** {{p|Grovyle}} ({{mdc|Grovyle|2|Explorers of Time, Darkness, and Sky}}) ** {{p|Aerodactyl}} ** {{p|Feraligatr}} ** {{p|Lapras}} ({{mdc|Lapras|2|Explorers of Time, Darkness, and Sky}}) ** {{p|Pelipper}} ** {{p|Dialga}} ([[Primal Dialga|Primal]]) ** {{p|Glalie}} ** {{p|Onix}} ** {{p|Unown}} (stone tablet) ** {{p|Sableye}} (multiple) ** {{p|Dusknoir}} ({{mdc|Dusknoir|2|Explorers of Time, Darkness, and Sky}}) ==Comparison with the game== * In the games, Dusknoir does not refer to the partner's Relic Fragment. * In the episode, Dusknoir leaves it to his Sableye to get rid of Chimchar, Piplup and Grovyle while he tries to escape back to the future with the Relic Fragment. In the games, Dusknoir battles alongside his Sableye. * The scene where Dusknoir charges up a Shadow Ball mirrors that of the games. While the games' dialogue refers to the trio "forcing their combined moves down Dusknoir's stomach", they are illustrated as simply deflecting Dusknoir's Shadow Ball back at him.
